GUI.TakeScreenshot.description: Takes a screenshot into the configured screenshot folder and answers with the files it wrote. Waits for the capture to be encoded, so every file it names is complete when the response arrives. Pass a returned path to Files.PrepareDownload to fetch the image. Answers Unavailable when no screenshot folder is configured.

params.name: content
params.description: composite captures the full display output, video only the video frame, both writes two files, the video frame and the full composite, from the same rendered frame

params.name: target
params.description: A plain .png file name, written to the configured folder, overwriting an existing file of that name. Names the composite; the video frame takes the matching "-video" name. Auto-numbered as screenshotNNNNN.png when omitted; the auto-numbered name runs out at 65535.

composite.description: Path of the full display output, under special://screenshots. Absent when only the video frame was captured.

video.description: Path of the video frame alone, under special://screenshots. Absent when only the composite was captured.

GUI.DeleteScreenshots.description: Deletes screenshots from the configured screenshot folder. Disabled unless <jsonrpc><allowscreenshotdeletion>true</allowscreenshotdeletion></jsonrpc> is set in advancedsettings.xml; answers Unavailable while it is off.

params.name: file
params.description: The one screenshot to delete, named as GUI.TakeScreenshot answered or as a plain file name. Every .png in the folder is deleted when omitted. Nothing outside the folder is reachable.
